source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines almost-everywhere intervention-versus-mechanism discrepancy and proves exact identifiability up to componentwise transformations under one stochastic perfect intervention per node.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 27–31, Definition 21, Theorem 22, Lemma 23, and Theorem 25
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Two coupled hard interventions whose pair has interventional discrepancy yield componentwise latent recovery; with observational data Theorem 25 also gives perfect latent-DAG identification.
The publication studies approximate nonlinear representation recovery when the mixing is close to a local isometry, using rigidity; it does not state a complete-interventional-law Hellinger modulus.
The paper supplies finite-sample graph and latent-variable recovery guarantees for its linear-transformation, soft-intervention setting, including consistency up to its stated equivalence classes.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the full-modulus headline explicitly foreground the new observable inverse-modulus object and state the two comparator boundary: qualitative exact recovery of Liang/Varıcı versus nonzero complete-family Hellinger stability.

Add a short transfer corollary identifying exactly which additional condition makes the Liang one-intervention discrepancy coincide with the paired-intervention contrast, separating that specialization from the Varıcı paired-intervention specialization.

Develop the full nonradial weighted incompressible coercivity proof or a legal counterexample; this is the only unresolved step between the audited radial frontier and the flagship full-class theorem.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the full incompressible-rigidity question as the decisive solve target and retain the radial theorem and audited Morse packet as mandatory calibration checks.
